claims.claim_text: As of June 30, 2024, Pony had registered 284 patents in China and 185 patents globally (incl. United States), reflecting a substantial autonomous-driving IP portfolio.
claims.subject: Pony AI
claims.source_quote: As of June 30, 2024, we have registered 284 patents, 128 copyrights, 538 trademarks in China, and 185 patents and 72 trademarks globally.

claims.claim_text: Pony tested driverless vehicles in the United States (California): it held a California DMV driverless testing permit and filed a recall notice at NHTSA's request after an accident; it conducts independent R&D and testing in the US.
claims.subject: Pony AI
claims.object_value: California DMV driverless testing permit; NHTSA recall filed; US R&D
claims.source_quote: We subsequently filed a recall notice at NHTSA's request. The NHTSA initiated a review in relation to this accident and our recall announcement, and the California Department of Motor Vehicles suspended our driverless testing permit.

claims.claim_text: Pony formed a joint venture with Toyota (TMC) and GTMC to mass-produce/deploy fully driverless robotaxis; Toyota is a strategic investor, principal shareholder and related party.
claims.subject: Pony AI
claims.object_value: Toyota/GTMC robotaxi JV; Toyota related-party shareholder
claims.source_quote: We have formed a joint venture with Toyota and GTMC to advance the mass production and large-scale deployment of fully driverless robotaxis in China. ... Toyota, a leading OEM and our strategic investor and related party.

claims.claim_text: Pony operates a fleet of over 250 robotaxis that has accumulated over 33.5 million km of autonomous mileage (incl. 3.9M km driverless), with PonyPilot public fare-charging service in all four China Tier-1 cities.
claims.subject: Pony AI
claims.source_quote: We currently operate a fleet of over 250 robotaxis, which has accumulated over 33.5 million kilometers of autonomous driving mileage, including over 3.9 million kilometers of driverless mileage.

claims.claim_text: Pony operates a fleet of over 190 robotrucks (incl. with Sinotrans, China's largest freight logistics company) accumulating ~5.0M km and 767M freight ton-kilometers.
claims.subject: Pony AI
claims.source_quote: We currently operate a fleet of over 190 robotrucks, both independently and in collaboration with Sinotrans, China's largest freight logistics company according to CIFA, which has amassed approximately 5.0 million kilometers of autonomous driving mileage.

claims.claim_text: Pony partnered with leading China OEMs SAIC, GAC and FAW to co-develop and mass-produce robotaxi vehicles, and with SANY to co-develop Level 4 robotrucks.
claims.subject: Pony AI
claims.source_quote: In addition, we have partnered with other leading OEMs, such as SAIC, GAC and FAW, to co-develop and mass produce robotaxi vehicles. ... we have collaborated with SANY, China's leading truck manufacturer, to co-develop Level 4 robotrucks.
